messages:
elaine: quick suggestion  instead of a full modal, let's try a right-hand create drawer (slide-over) so users keep the list in view. mock uploaded.

 tom: drawer reads nicer. CTA debate: 'Create & reveal' vs 'Create (keep secret)'. many expect to see the token immediately but we should surface both options.

 maria: dev POV  drawer is easy. important: keyboard tab order must be linear: open -> name -> scope selector -> reveal toggle -> copy/download -> close. need escape handling.

 nick: a11y: when revealing the token announce via aria-live: 'Token visible. Copy now, this is a one-shot secret.' add role=dialog and trap focus. don't auto-select for screen reader users.

 tom: copy idea: primary = 'Create and reveal token', alt = 'Create without revealing'. small inline note: 'This secret is one-shot  save it now.' add an info link to docs.

 maria: backend: if reveal=false return a one-time download URL TTL ~30s. API sketch: POST /api-keys {name, reveal:false} -> {id, downloadUrl, expiresAt}.

 nick: make download link accessible, include an aria-label like 'Download keyfile, expires in 30 seconds', and ensure rel="noopener". announce expiry updates politely (30s, 10s, 5s).

 elaine: empty state rewrite: 'No keys yet. Create a token to get started  each secret is shown only once.' CTA: 'Create API token' + small 'Learn how tokens work' link.

 tom: rotation UX: propose a guided drawer flow: Step 1 create replacement, Step 2 flip clients, Step 3 revoke old. show progress and explicit CTA per step.

 maria: UI checklist for rotate should be keyboard-first with explicit actionable steps and an option to auto-run a health check after flip.

 nick: accessibility checklist: focus management, role=dialog, aria-labelledby for title, aria-describedby for one-shot note, visible focus rings, aria-live for copy/download/expiry events.

 elaine: next: tom will update Figma with drawer + CTA variations, nick will draft the a11y checklist, maria will prototype the one-time-download + curl example, i'll refine microcopy and schedule a 5-developer quick test.

 deploy-bot: figma uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/drawer-create-v1  version: drawer-create-v1 :rocket:
